Pump rate of 0-200 cbm/h is required. WASTE WATER: min. 300 m³. BILGE WATER: min. 300 m³. MARINE GAS OIL (MGO): min. 400 m³ divided into two tanks of min. 200 m³ each (to be proven by tank arrangement plan indicating the tanks for vessel’s own usage and clients usage). Pump rate of 0-200 cbm/h is required.
